title: Home practical guide and safety card: paper bridge
subject: Science
unit: Summer 1: Working scientifically, revision through enquiry (Revolution)
source: Written for science/y6 lessons 29, 30 (Home practical guide and safety card: paper bridge (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 29: Fair test: planning a Victorian-style paper bridge. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To find out which paper bridge shape holds most coins
equipment: Two piles of books the same height
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Lay a flat sheet across as a bridge
Add coins one at a time to the middle until it collapses; record the number
Fold a new sheet into a zigzag (concertina) bridge and test it the same way
Try a tube or a folded edge bridge

questions.q: The one thing we change is the...
Big question: how can a flat sheet of paper hold coins?
questions.a: Change its shape: folding makes it stiffer and stronger.
